bio: Drew Solomonson is a visual designer, instructor, and adjudicator who marched as a euphonium player with the Phantom Regiment Drum and Bugle Corps (2001, 2003-2005). He spent roughly 12 years on Phantom Regiment's visual staff, serving as visual caption head in his final two years. A graduate of the University of Kentucky, Solomonson has written drill for numerous high schools, drum corps, and universities, and continues to work as a DCI adjudicator.

Ben Hylton is a brass educator and music designer who has served as Brass Caption Head at The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps since 2017, after working as a brass instructor there in 2013-2014, and taught with the Crossmen in 2013. Teaching drum corps since 1999, Hylton has been on staff with corps including Carolina Crown, The Cadets, Magic of Orlando, Crossmen, Blue Knights, Troopers, Blue Stars, and The Academy. He runs Hylton Music Design.

Brad Hughes is an East Texas native and brass educator who earned a Bachelor of Music with All-Level Teacher Certification from the University of Houston (Magna Cum Laude, 2012). He marched tuba with the Phantom Regiment Drum and Bugle Corps from 2006 to 2009, serving as tuba section leader his final three years, and previously marched with Teal Sound in 2005. Hughes joined Phantom Regiment's educational staff in 2012 as a brass and visual instructor, and earlier worked as a low brass instructor at Arizona Academy (2010-2011). He has also been on the brass staff at Pacific Crest.

Brad Toth is a brass educator who was hired as brass caption head for the Phantom Regiment Drum and Bugle Corps, the first corps he auditioned for back in 1996. He previously served as brass caption head for the Blue Knights, a role he held beginning in 2011-2012. Toth teaches instrumental music at Byron Nelson High School in the Fort Worth, Texas area and works as a band director, drum corps instructor, and clinician across the United States and internationally.

Calvin Fackrell is a drum corps visual instructor and designer who served as Caption Supervisor for the visual department at the Seattle Cascades Drum and Bugle Corps (2016-2017) and worked on the visual staff of the Troopers in 2012. His credits appear in multiple DCI souvenir yearbooks documenting his visual teaching work across these corps.

Chris Cowling is a full-time visual designer and educator based in Ontario, California. He marched with the Pacific Crest Drum and Bugle Corps from 2001-2005 and later taught there as a visual tech (2007-2009) and visual caption manager (2010-2012), returning in 2015-2016. In 2016 he joined the Santa Clara Vanguard, where he taught through 2021, and he has also been on the visual staff of Pulse Percussion. He currently serves as a visual instructor for the Phantom Regiment.

Chris Tomsa is a brass educator, arranger, and program administrator who has instructed and arranged for many leading drum and bugle corps including the Madison Scouts, Phantom Regiment, Glassmen, Colts, Capital Regiment, and 27th Lancers. He served as a brass co-caption head for the Mandarins (including the 2017 season alongside Mark Trulson) and later became Brass Program Director for the Madison Scouts. In 2024 he was inducted into the Colts Hall of Fame for ten years of work there as music arranger, program coordinator, and assistant director.

Christian Do is a Southern California percussionist and designer who has performed with POW Percussion (2015), Pulse Percussion (2016-2017), and the Pacific Crest Drum and Bugle Corps (2018). Since 2016 he has served as Lead Designer and Ensemble Coordinator for Los Amigos High School in Fountain Valley, California, working with both the marching band and indoor drumline programs.
